summary: This video provides a walkthrough on how to redeem active promo codes in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. The creator demonstrates the menu path to enter redemption codes via the settings screen. Several active codes are verified in-game, yielding substantial rewards such as Heliolite Dice, Wyrmarrow, Master Scrolls, bread, and gold. Viewers are advised to redeem the codes promptly before they expire and to check for variations.
tips: To redeem codes, tap the menu icon in the top right, select the Settings cog, go to Service, find Redemption Code Pack, click 'Go', and paste your codes.
Try numerical variations for certain creator codes (such as Fastidious11 and Fastidious12), as multiple versions may be active.
Check your in-game mailbox immediately after redeeming to claim your items before mail expiration.
title: NEW ACTIVE CODES! Claim FREE Rewards Before They Expire! | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
